about: What the Android kiosk charges, generated by RUNNING its engines (pos-android app/src/test/java/il/co/runnersys/pos/KioskPricingCorpusTest.kt) over the scenarios below: MenuCodec / Menu.groupsFor, DishDraft (ModifierMath, the dish window's taps — "מעט / הרבה / בצד" too), MealDraft, PromotionMapper (Moshi DTOs) + PromotionEngine, Cart.withPromotions / withVoucherDiscounts / totals ("vouchers": discount vouchers; "goodsVouchers": coverByVoucher, the legs of the payment), KioskTip / KioskCustomer.tipOf, SaleRepository's item and transaction fields. The Windows and browser kiosks (pos-server client/src/lib/kioskMoney.ts, kioskVouchers.ts, kioskWebOrders.ts) must reproduce every expected figure. Never edit by hand: regenerate.
